lines.t: Behold, My Kingdom comes, and My will shall be done on earth as in Heaven.
Even as I had purposed it from the beginning, so shall it be done to this generation.
Behold, My Kingdom comes, and My will shall be done on earth as in Heaven.
For My throne is set high above the highest heavens, and the earth is but a footstool set beneath My feet.
FOR I AM THE LORD! YAHUWAH IS MY NAME!
